title: Scenario library T8: export verified scenario apps to a new gallery repository — source, run record, auto screenshots and the 8–10 问数 transcripts, rebuilt per release
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ④ coordination child of objectstack-ai/cloud#3600 (scenario-library epic), item T8. Maintainer-directed (verbatim, Claude Code session 2026-11-05): 「画廊 可以新开仓库」 · 「画廊是主要的引流手段 ，repo:www.objectos.ai 需要有配套的落地页面」.

Blocked-by: #30795

(#30292, the runner, landed as PR #30746. The exporter now waits for the `demo` + card `code` namespace of #30795, ruled on objectstack-ai/cloud#3600 comment 6676044775.)

Business rationale:
- The maintainer names the gallery the **primary acquisition channel**.
- A gallery made of verified, regenerated scenario apps cannot rot the way the v15-pinned templates repo did: every framework release rebuilds it.
- Its proof artifacts double as the landing pages' content on www.objectos.ai (a sibling card there consumes them).

## Scope

1. **An exporter on top of the local runner (#30292).** For every scenario card whose run record passes all three halves (Build, Run-问数, Run-operations), write to a new gallery repository:
   - the generated app's metadata source;
   - its run record and scorecard;
   - **auto-captured screenshots** (Playwright against the booted app: list, kanban or calendar where tagged, record page, dashboard);
   - the card's **8–10 问数 Q&A transcript**, with per-persona answers, so a reader sees the permission boundary hold.
2. **Only passing cards are exported.** A failing card stays out, and its failure goes to the gap radar (T6).
3. **Rebuilt on each framework release.** Exporting the same card again replaces the old output, so the gallery never pins an old version.
4. **A machine-readable index** (one JSON manifest: scenario id, function, title zh/en, screenshot paths, Q&A count, framework version, run date). The www.objectos.ai landing pages build from it.
5. **Card content is generic only.** Per the D1 ruling, ⛔ no customer-derived scenario is ever exported.

## Preconditions (maintainer-side)

- **The gallery repository must be created by the maintainer.** A seat creates no repositories. Suggested name: `objectstack-ai/gallery`; the maintainer decides.
- It is a generated-output repository. It needs a fleet seat only if it gets standing work, so a write path for the exporter (a release workflow or the relay) is part of this card's design.

## Out of scope

- The www.objectos.ai landing pages (sibling card in that repo).
- The "try it in ObjectOS cloud" deep link (pending decision Q6 on cloud#3600).
- The templates repo's fate (pending on cloud#3600).

Reader: the epic PM of cloud#3600 dispatches this once #30292 merges and the gallery repository exists.
